title: Private Chicago Loop Architecture Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the historic Loop District of Chicago on a private walking tour that delves into the city's architectural legacy. With an expert guide, visit iconic skyscrapers and stunning lobbies, learning the fascinating stories behind their designs. This 2.5-hour tour is perfect for architecture enthusiasts and curious travelers alike, providing a unique perspective on the birthplace of modern skyscrapers. Whether you’re a local or a visitor, discover why Chicago's skyline is renowned worldwide.

- Private tour lasting 2.5 hours, perfect for families and small groups
- Visit landmark buildings like The Sullivan Center and The Rookery
- Expert local guide shares insider knowledge about architectural history
- Flexible meeting points available for your convenience
